## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Tarragona, Spain. It starts at Pla de la Seu.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> The Cathedral of Tarragona sits at one of the highest points in the city. The site was previously that of a Roman temple and a Moorish Mosque but has been a Christian institution since around the 12th century.
>
> Explore chapels, the cloister, and the garden with its resident turtles in this Spanish national monument.
>
> See relics like processional maces, reliquaries, and chalices – there would be more if not for Napoleon's sticky fingers!

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €13.50. It was rated 4.4 out of 5 from 51 ratings and 24 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
